tex_content.html:
Corollary
Source: topping:page-0047 1. ch3:2.2\group maximum-principle

For a Ricci flow $g(t)$ on a closed manifold $\M $, if $R\geq \alpha \in \RR $ at $t=0$, then $R\geq \alpha $ throughout the time interval of the flow.
